scripts.// start: Interactive setup: choose global skill folders (~/.agents/skills and ~/.claude/skills).
scripts.// claude: Same as release --install (kept for the old command name).
scripts.// sync: Synchronizes skills on demand using the new skill script.
scripts.// sync:force: Overwrites target copies even when they are newer than this repo.
scripts.// update-skills: Validates plugin manifests, checks SKILL.md metadata, and re-audits cross-references.
scripts.// release: One command: fix metadata, bump changed plugin versions, validate, audit. --install also refreshes Claude Code; --commit commits locally (never pushes).
